title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Inline actions that leave the code intact
summary: Surround With turned `$name` into `name`, "Remove expired TODO" cut a URL in half, Extract String Resource made a placeholder out of `$100`, and removing an unused Gradle dependency left its block behind. All fixed, along with method separators in Hilt ViewModels, `!!` and swatch decorations that ignored the setting, and dispatcher hints on comments.

highlights.title: Surround With and TODO fixes that keep the code
highlights.description: The selection is no longer read as snippet syntax (`$name` and `\\d` survive), and the expired TODO quick fix removes exactly the comment: `"http://x.io" // TODO` keeps its URL, a block comment stays closed, a TODO in a string is left alone.

highlights.title: Extract string resource that compiles
highlights.description: `$100` is a literal, Java has no templates, nested quotes in `${…}` are read, `%` is doubled next to placeholders, a leading `@` is escaped, `@Preview(…)` no longer hides `@Composable`, and a String gets `getString(R.string.x)` rather than an Int.

highlights.title: Decorations that stay put
highlights.description: Method separators in a wrapped Hilt class header, `!!` and hex swatches that respect the setting on every keystroke, dispatcher hints off comments and strings, constants folded to their own file first, KMP badges scoped to the module.

sections.heading: Code actions
bullets: Surround With escapes `$`, `\\` and `}` of the selection.
"Remove expired TODO" works one line at a time and removes the exact comment span.
Extract String Resource: literal `$100`, Java literals, nested `${…}` quotes, `%%`, `\\@`, multi-line `@Preview`, event lambdas, `getString` for Strings.
Removing an unused dependency takes its `{ … }` block with it.

sections.heading: Decorations and lenses
bullets: Method separators in a wrapped class header; a `"{"` in a string no longer shifts them.
`!!` highlight and hex swatches respect the setting and the language on each keystroke, in the active editor.
Dispatcher hints skip `viewLifecycleOwner`, comments, strings and `apiKey`.
Const folding prefers the file's own declaration; `Color.RED` is not `Palette.RED`.
State provenance counts code only and says "in this file"; KMP badges show the module's own targets.
